theme: Personal finance basics: emergency fund, 50/30/20 budgeting, good vs bad debt
headline: Build Your Safety Net First
body: An emergency fund covers 3-6 months expenses. It prevents relying on high-cost debt during unexpected situations.
caption: Having liquid savings protects you when life happens unexpectedly. This foundation lets you handle surprises without financial stress. #EmergencyFund #PersonalFinance #FinancialWellness #SmartSaving #MoneyManagement
